ppi.title: Clinical Timing Tip: {med}
ppi.body: {med} works 3x better when taken 30 minutes BEFORE breakfast on an empty stomach to maximize proton pump inhibition.

thyroid.title: Empty Stomach Protocol: {med}
thyroid.body: Take {med} first thing in the morning with a full glass of water, at least 45-60 minutes before breakfast or coffee.

antidiabetic.title: Meal Correlation Tip: {med}
antidiabetic.body: Take {med} WITH or immediately AFTER meals to minimize gastrointestinal discomfort and ensure smooth glycemic control.

antihypertensive.title: Dosing Consistency: {med}
antihypertensive.body: Maintain fixed daily timing for {med}. Evening dosing of BP medications helps maintain natural nocturnal blood pressure dipping.

statin.title: Chronotherapy Tip: {med}
statin.body: {med} is most effective when taken in the EVENING or at BEDTIME because hepatic cholesterol synthesis peaks overnight.

nsaid.title: Stomach Protection: {med}
nsaid.body: Always take {med} after food or with milk to prevent gastric irritation and protect stomach mucosa.

antibiotic.title: Full Course Compliance: {med}
antibiotic.body: Complete the full prescribed duration of {med} at even intervals, even if symptoms subside early.

supplement.title: Absorption Tip: {med}
supplement.body: Take {med} with main meals containing healthy fats for superior fat-soluble nutrient bioavailability.

general.title: Timing Guidance: {med}
general.body: Take {med} consistently at your scheduled time each day to maintain therapeutic plasma concentrations.
